sources.title: LoRA Fine-tuning | deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-MoE | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: LoRA offers a parameter-efficient alternative to full fine-tuning, allowing you to adapt the DeepSeek-MoE 16B model to downstream tasks with significantly reduced memory requirements.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-FineTuning/finetune_deepseek_R1_LoRa.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: Conclusion This guide demonstrates how to fine-tune the DeepSeek-V1.5 7B model for reasoning tasks using LoRA and Hugging Face libraries. By following these steps, you can adapt the model to your specific use case and save it for future inference.
